name: MergePdfFiles
label: Merge PDF Files
description: Merges multiple PDF files into a new one.

fields.name: PdfFilePaths
fields.label: PDF File Paths
fields.description: The paths of the PDF files to merge.

fields.name: OutputPdfPath
fields.label: Output PDF Path
fields.description: The full file path where the merged PDF will be saved. Include the complete path with the new PDF filename and .pdf extension (e.g., C:\Documents\MergedFile.pdf)
